description: This file defines utilities for creating and managing a Spark Streaming Kinesis data stream, including classes for initial position and metrics level, a UTF-8 decoder function, and the KinesisUtils class with a createStream method to connect to Kinesis streams.

classes.name: InitialPositionInStream
classes.description: Class defining constants for initial position in Kinesis stream (LATEST, TRIM_HORIZON).

classes.name: MetricsLevel
classes.description: Class defining constants for metrics level (DETAILED, SUMMARY, NONE).

classes.name: KinesisUtils
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to create a Kinesis data stream in Spark Streaming.

methods.name: utf8_decoder
methods.description: Decodes bytes to UTF-8 string, returns None if input is None.

methods.name: createStream
methods.description: Creates a Spark Streaming DStream from a Kinesis stream, with parameters for configuration, credentials, and decoding function.
